description: User wants to understand ELSS lock-in and exit load for SIP investments

payload.query: I want to invest in ELSS through SIP. What is the lock-in period and exit load?

questions: Are you asking about ELSS (tax-saving) mutual funds or non-ELSS equity funds?
Do you plan to redeem within 1 year of investment?
Is this a lumpsum investment or SIP?

fee_details.text: ELSS funds have a mandatory 3-year lock-in period as per Section 80C of Income Tax Act. No redemption is allowed during this period.
For SIP investments in ELSS, each installment has a separate 3-year lock-in from its investment date.
Exit load (if applicable) is deducted from the redemption NAV. For example, 1% exit load on ₹10,000 redemption = ₹100 deduction.
Exit load collected goes back to the scheme (not to AMC), benefiting continuing investors as per SEBI regulations.

explanation.disclaimer: This information is based on official sources and current regulations. Always verify exact fees from the fund's Scheme Information Document (SID) or factsheet.
